messages:
mira: Heads-up — staging e2e started failing after we bumped webimage to v2.0.1. This is blocking today's promo window.

deploy-bot: deploybot: auto-pause activated for promotion (promo-id: 2026-03-22-1015) :warning: promotion halted due to failing staging smoke checks.

jonas: Can you paste the failing logs?

mira: Pasting the headless test failure we saw:
```
ERROR headless-render-test.js › should_render_homepage
TimeoutError: element not found after 30s
at puppeteer..
Stack: ...render.waitForSelector -> timed out
```

priya: Looks like headless chrome hitting OOM / timeout in that image. The new image pulled in chrome 111 -> 116, maybe different flags. Can we try a CI rerun with increased headless memory flags?

evan: CI rerun queued (ci-bot job #4567). I'll add --disable-gpu and bump timeout to 60s for the rerun. ETA ~6m.

sasha: If the rerun still flakes, my vote is to pin back to webimage:v1.23 and manually promote. We have a change window to hit and can't keep blocking.

jonas: +1 — pin to v1.23 while infra + image owners debug.

ci-bot: rerun finished — 2/5 flaky tests passed, 3 still failing. Failures correlate to headless render step and viewport resize.

mira: Confirming rerun didn't stabilize. Decision required: rollback image or keep investigating and delay promo. We need an unblock plan.

platform-team: We can push a quick manifest patch to pin image to v1.23 and run a small canary in eu-west. Will coordinate the patch and start canary within 10 min.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused -> manual approval required. To continue, create a rollout note and request manual override.

mira: I'll open a PR to pin to webimage:v1.23 and add a release-note explaining: "staging e2e regressions after webimage v2.0.1; pin until debug complete." Tagging @release-manager.

ev an: I will reach out to the webimage owners to repro locally and collect chrome flags / memory metrics.

priya: Filing follow-up ticket INF-2981 to investigate chrome diff and headless flags (mem, no-sandbox, viewport).

mira: Plan: pin -> canary -> if canary green, manual promote and unblock release window. If canary fails, escalate and consider rollback across envs.

release-manager: Acknowledged. Please attach the PR link and the canary results. We'll hold release notes until we confirm canary status.

mira: Thanks all. Marking this thread as blocked->pin action in progress. I'll post when canary completes. :thumbsup:
